rules.summary_must_derive_from_reconciled_camp: Campaign operator summaries must derive from the canonical campaign record, gate decisions, and reconciliation facts rather than transcript prose.
rules.proof_gaps_must_remain_visible: Proof gaps, ambiguity, and stale-or-missing durable references must stay explicit instead of being flattened into cheerful progress.
rules.review_and_blocked_states_must_stay_dist: waiting_review, blocked, partial_ready, and uncertain are separate operator states and must not be collapsed together.
rules.budget_posture_must_reuse_campaign_recon: Budget posture must reuse the campaign reconciliation rollup instead of campaign-local ad hoc accounting.
